source.read: T78 F18, 11.10.2026, 22:43 to 23:15 UTC. From this container publications.blum.com, www.blum.com, e-services.blum.com, d2.blum.com, static.richelieu.com, xcart.wurthlac.com, www.cabinetparts.com and even example.com answer getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND in WebFetch, and curl through the egress proxy gets 403 to CONNECT (the proxy status at 22:43 UTC records connect_rejected for every outside host), so NO catalogue page and NO PDF was opened. Every value below was read from web-search result snippets of the named URL; `page` is the catalogue page the search index attaches to that URL. Nothing is taken from memory; a value nobody printed is null and the sentence beside it says so.
source.caveat: three kinds of value: `printed` (as the snippet of the named URL shows it), null (not found, with a note) and `reading` (an inference across snippets, said so). The catalogue prints ranges with a dash; this file writes `to` or a two-number array in its place (CLAUDE.md law: no dash). Every number is owner to confirm against the catalogue page itself. The 2026 edition the index also returned prints `Catalogue 2027/2028` in its header; where a value exists only there it is marked `2026 edition`.

engineNotes.noHoles: CLAUDE.md T78 law: a bought mechanism is a line and a body, never a hole, until its manufacturer drilling is here with a page number. The only lift mechanism drilling with numbers is HF top (H / X / Y above) and its datum is unread, so every one of the four systems stays a BOM line and a body with zero holes; the leaves carry no hinge cups except the HF upper leaf (CLIP top 120 unsprung, cup 35) and the HF lower leaf (the centre hinge, cup 35, pattern owner to confirm).
engineNotes.selectLiftUnit: engine/lifts.js selectLiftUnit reads power_units_hk_top and rules.hk_limits only (T19). HS top and HL top select by cabinet height AND front weight bands, not by a single LF; HF top selects by LF with its own three bands and by lever arm cabinet height. A kit builder must read systems.hs / systems.hl / systems.hf here and may not reuse the HK ladder for them.
engineNotes.overlap: see shared.overlapRule: the catalogue recommends the MORE powerful mechanism in an overlap; the engine (T19 F5.2) picks the smaller; owner to decide.
engineNotes.weight18kg: systems.hk.frontWeightMaxKg 18 for two mechanisms is a second cap beside the LF range; a front over 18 kg is refused in words even inside the 22K2900 range unless a third mechanism is fitted.
engineNotes.dashes: no dash character anywhere in this key; ranges are `to` or arrays.
